title: CAM-54 slice 2: per-phase backend config accessor + ConfigScreen wiring (readPhaseBackend mirroring readPhaseModel)
description:
Slice 2 of the CAM-54 epic (Codex CLI as an alternative LLM backend). Follows CAM-339 (slice 1: design-spike ADR-0046/0047 + BackendAdapter seam, claude refactored into an adapter, zero behavior change). This slice is the per-phase backend selection plumbing that ADR-0047 Consequences prescribes as the mechanical follow-up (readBackend becomes a per-phase accessor mirroring readPhaseModel). It lands BEFORE any real codex dispatch (slice 3), because a CodexAdapter selectable only via the current global backend key would force all four worker actors to codex at once; mixed per-actor backend is the operator requirement stated in ADR-0046.

IN SCOPE (this slice only):
1. Add readPhaseBackend(phase, configPath?) in src/config/models.ts, mirroring readPhaseModel (models.ts:110-125) exactly: read config[backend][phase], defensive try/catch, fall back to the existing global backend form, then to DEFAULTS.backend (claude).
2. TOML shape (design decision, resolved by mirroring [models]): per-phase keys under [backend] (e.g. [backend] with implement=claude, review=claude), with BACK-COMPAT fallback preserved: a per-phase key wins, else the existing global form (top-level backend scalar OR [backend].name), else DEFAULTS.backend. No existing project.toml breaks.
3. Repoint the worker call sites to per-phase: loop.ts:1014 -> readPhaseBackend(implementer); review.ts:338 -> readPhaseBackend(reviewer) (planner/auditor call sites too if they resolve backend).
4. ConfigScreen.tsx: render backend selection PER-PHASE (like the per-phase MODEL_OPTIONS Selects on each tab) instead of once on the Global tab; extend ConfigChoices.backend from string to Record<Phase,string> mirroring models.
5. CODEX_GUARD_NOTICE stays as-is (now fires per-phase instead of globally) until the real codex adapter lands.

OUT OF SCOPE (later CAM-54 slices, do NOT do here): the real CodexAdapter dispatch impl (slice 3), mixed-backend live run, codex model-id population, orchestrator-persona/retry-launcher/auth-preflight codex parity. BackendAdapter/buildSpawnArgv seam needs ZERO changes.

ACCEPTANCE: readPhaseBackend exists and mirrors readPhaseModel with the documented fallback chain; existing project.toml (global [backend].name) still resolves for every phase; ConfigScreen renders per-phase backend Selects; both worker call sites resolve backend per-phase; typecheck + full test suite green; zero behavior change for anyone who has not set per-phase backend (still all claude).
